digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions workflow configuration and policy enforcement
propositions: Four GitHub workflows (test.yml, optionality.yml, prompt-eval.yml, verify-identity.yml) must exclude the tickets branch from push-triggered execution by adding 'tickets' to their branches-ignore lists.

A new enumerating test must verify that no workflow file in .github/workflows/ triggers on tickets-branch pushes by reading the directory from disk rather than maintaining a hardcoded name list, preventing silent regression if new workflows are added.

Documentation must warn adopters that auto-push-on-every-write patterns (like rebar's tickets branch) can saturate CI pools if workflows trigger on all branches, with guidance to use schedules instead and cross-links from user-guide and config docs.
All schedule cron expressions and gerrit-verify.yaml's workflow_dispatch-only triggering must remain unchanged after the modification, verified by git diff and literal cron assertions in the test.
Topic-branch push CI (e.g., wip-some-topic) must remain functional after excluding tickets, tested by asserting non-tickets branches still match the four edited workflows' push filters.
